components.title: Signal Finder
components.description: Lists the seat-heating and steering-wheel-heating entries of this head unit's interface catalogue; read-only

components.title: Heat Watch Seats
components.description: Live log of the climate interface's values while the car's seat heating buttons are pressed; read-only

components.title: Heat Watch Wheel
components.description: Live log of the steering wheel climate interface's values while its heating button is pressed; read-only

components.title: Heat Watch Master
components.description: Live log of the climate master interface's values (seat and steering wheel heating) while the heating buttons are pressed; read-only

components.title: Heat Test
components.description: Buttons that each send one seat or steering wheel heating command by one route, with the car's answer and the live levels

components.title: Climate Strip
components.description: Seat and steering wheel heating: your seat, the passenger seat and the wheel, with the levels the car reports; runs the Climate Bar's buttons

tools.title: Climate Bar
tools.description: Seat and steering wheel heating buttons in the climate bar, over BMW's own indicators; needs Climate Strip and the Renderer
